claims.main_splits: scenario and policy-instance disjoint; shared policy structures and inspiration events
claims.challenge: six distinct policy families and inspiration events absent from main splits; shared rendering engine

curation_scope: 96 preselected training records audited by Jev; all records checked deterministically. Whole flagged training groups quarantined. Evaluation never filtered by Jev.

training_contract.suggested_sampling: uniform family, then uniform scenario group, then uniform variant
training_contract.suggested_loss: categorical cross-entropy divided by log(number of options), averaged across families
training_contract.warning: The historical overnight trainer hardcodes three old families. Do not pass this corpus to it unchanged; use a trainer that consumes all manifest families and normalizes accumulation correctly.
